title: Northgate Delivery Crew Service Schedule: Teardown Withheld on Changed-Mind Special Order Refunds
content:
When Northgate Special Order merchandise was set up by a delivery crew and the member returns it for a changed mind, the crew's teardown is recovered from the refund. This schedule of Northgate Purchases & Returns applies to the changed-mind refund on a sale line that earned no Annual Reward.

## Crew teardown withheld from the changed-mind refund

When the Northgate delivery appointment that delivered the purchase was a Northgate White Glove Delivery, 30.00 per returned unit is withheld for the crew's teardown; when it was a Northgate Room of Choice Delivery, 15.00 per returned unit is withheld; otherwise no teardown is withheld.

The service level is the one recorded on the Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment linked to the purchase. The returned units are the units on the received return authorization. The crew teardown withheld is rounded half up to the cent and subtracted from the returned value.

| Service level of the delivering appointment | Teardown withheld per returned unit |
|---|---|
| Northgate White Glove Delivery | 30.00 |
| Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | 15.00 |
| Northgate Curbside Delivery, Northgate Threshold Delivery or any other level | none |
| no Northgate delivery appointment | none |

## Worked teardown (hypothetical returns)

| Returned units | Delivering appointment | Teardown withheld |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | Northgate White Glove Delivery | 60.00 |
| 3 | Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | 45.00 |
| 4 | Northgate Threshold Delivery | none |
